PASS

Reviewed the current uncommitted cc-transcript Codex normalization and cursor implementation, including the coordinator-authorized lossless patch delta. The implementation target advanced from `codex.3` to `codex.5` during review. This review did not edit source files.

## Resolved during review

Four concrete defects were reproduced and reported while the review was active. The current source fixes each one and adds focused regression coverage.

- `rust/crates/core/src/codex/protocol.rs:23#drs9` now recognizes only explicit `mcp__` namespaces as Model Context Protocol tools. Current native `clock.sleep` records retain the name `sleep`, while `mcp__clock.sleep` normalizes to `mcp__clock__sleep`.
- `rust/crates/core/src/codex/lower.rs:230#a9g1` now keeps modern same-thread cumulative usage separate from legacy echoes and prefers the modern series whenever present. The original `legacy=100, modern=200, later legacy=150` reproducer now reports `200`; later same-thread corrections and foreign-thread records have dedicated tests.
- `rust/crates/core/src/codex/execution.rs:104#prjq` now gives completion-only tool blocks an empty read-only public input mapping while retaining `ToolOrigin.native_input=None` and semantic telemetry in `block.call`. The stable v14 mapping contract and the no-invented-native-input contract both hold.
- `rust/crates/core/src/toolcall.rs:508#zdc0` now implements `PatchEdit` equality over its public fields, excluding private native chunks. Rust equality matches the Python field list at `rust/crates/py/src/views/toolcall.rs:951#vxxn`, while `apply_to` still distinguishes native reconstructable edits from telemetry fragments.

## Verified focus areas

Direct and completion records deduplicate to one execution in both arrival orders. Physical rows remain and result pairing uses the scoped execution identity. Assistant-row completion results feed incremental `ActivityLift` as well as compact CLI rendering and statistics, plus error accounting. Native namespaces remain native, explicit Model Context Protocol namespaces normalize once, and code-mode JavaScript stays opaque. Nested operations come only from execution telemetry.

Fork identity uses the first valid `session_meta.id`; repeated parent metadata does not overwrite the child rollout identity. Local fork samples matched the child-first record shape covered by the regression. Token usage keeps the last authoritative same-thread `thread_token_usage` observation and ignores foreign-thread modern records. It retains the legacy fallback and context window without summing cumulative totals.

`TranscriptCursor` keeps Arc-backed immutable snapshots and reports the earliest changed entry. It survives every byte split including UTF-8 splits, retains provisional final rows, counts newline-complete physical rows, and revises earlier normalization for late metadata.

Python exposes the cursor, origin, semantic calls, and completion-only input mapping consistently with the Rust model. The Rust Swift bridge and generated Swift package agree on Codex activity, including native completion clearing a pending call.

The native patch matcher preserves selectors and exact line vectors. It also retains EOF placement and rename destinations, along with public field equality. Targeted cases agreed with `codex --codex-run-as-apply-patch` for repeated lines, selectors, EOF, blank context, and Unicode normalization. Insert and delete behavior matched, as did rename behavior.

## Verification

The following checks passed against the post-fix source.

- `uv run --no-sync pytest -q`
- `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 cargo test -p cc-transcript-core`; 419 tests passed
- `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 cargo test -p cc-transcript-core --no-default-features`; 320 tests passed
- `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 cargo test -p cc-transcript-cli`; 15 tests passed
- `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 cargo test -p cc_transcript_swift`; four tests passed
- `swift test --package-path swift`; 11 tests passed
- `cargo fmt --check`
- The original usage reproducer returns modern total `200`. The namespace reproducer returns native name `sleep`. Completion input is a `ReadOnlyDict` while `native_input` remains `None`.

The prose gate passed with zero findings using `slop-cop check /tmp/codex-port-review-transcript.txt --lang=markdown`.

## Limits

This verdict covers the current uncommitted source and generated Swift package. The review did not build or install the final `14.19.0+codex.5` wheel. It also did not rebuild the release CLI or rerun the documentation build. Artifact hashes from `/tmp/codex-port-transcript.txt` describe the superseded `codex.3` build and must not be attributed to the reviewed `codex.5` source.
